v.title: BBC’s Football Quiz Frenzy: Who Am I? Plus More Brain Teasers for Barça Fans
v.excerpt: BBC Sport’s daily football quiz—Who Am I? plus quick challenges—tests Barça fans’ knowledge and keeps the community engaged.
v.body:
## Quick take
BBC Sport drops a daily football quiz that tests your knowledge with a Who Am I? challenge plus a fast‑paced Five in Five and a mind‑bending Brainteaser. It’s the perfect way to keep your Barça brain sharp while the season heats up.

## What happened
The BBC’s “Who Am I?” segment asks readers to guess a football figure from cryptic clues, while the Five in Five section throws in five rapid questions about players, clubs and tournaments. The Brainteaser pushes logic skills, featuring a puzzle that even seasoned pundits find tricky. All three quizzes are timed, encouraging quick thinking and rewarding those who can answer correctly before the clock runs out.

The article also notes that the quizzes are updated daily, with fresh questions each week. The BBC encourages fans to submit their answers on social media using #BBCFootballQuiz, turning the exercise into a community challenge. For Barça supporters, it offers a fun way to test their knowledge of La Liga rivals, the Champions League and even the history of FC Barcelona.

## Why it matters
- **Keeps Barça fans mentally sharp**: The rapid‑fire format mirrors the pace of La Liga, helping players and supporters alike stay alert to tactical nuances and key moments in matches. A sharp mind can spot patterns in opponent play, an advantage on game day.
- **Highlights knowledge gaps**: By comparing your answers to those of other fans, you’ll see where you’re missing facts—be it about Pep Guardiola’s former Barça squad or the current squad’s transfer history. That insight can shape your pre‑match discussions and predictions.
- **Builds a sense of community**: The shared experience of tackling the same quizzes daily fosters camaraderie among Barça fans worldwide, strengthening the fanbase and providing a platform for spirited debate and learning.

## What's next
Tomorrow’s quiz will focus on the upcoming La Liga fixtures, with clues about player form and tactical setups. Watch the BBC’s “Who Am I?” segment to see if you can name the star player who scored the winning goal in the last Champions League knockout tie. Keep your phone handy, answer quickly, and share your score on Twitter with #BBCFootballQuiz to challenge your Barça mates. Good luck, and may the best fan win!

*Source: [Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cq0l31gw1809o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
